lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks for calling the workshop. I'm the digital assistant. This call is recorded for quality. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm unhappy about the job that was done last Tuesday. I want to speak to someone in charge.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: I'm sorry you've had a poor experience. I can request a callback from the site manager. Can I take your name?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Megan Pryce. My number is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, one.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: Thanks, Megan. I only caught nine digits. Could you repeat the full number, please?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Sorry. Zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero, one two four.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: That's zero seven seven zero zero; nine zero zero; one two four. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes. I just want someone to explain what went wrong.

lines.speaker: foyer
lines.text: I've noted that you'd like an explanation. I'll pass your callback request to the site manager. I can't confirm when they'll be available.
